# Neuro & Evil Karaoke API — Your uploads

Base URL: https://api.neurokaraoke.com

Songs uploaded by the authenticated user. All endpoints require a bearer token.

### `POST /api/user/song/upload` — Upload a song

Auth: `Bearer`

Uploads an audio file as `multipart/form-data`. The file goes in `File`. `Title` and `Artist` are optional. When omitted, they are read from the file's tags. If `PlaylistId` is supplied, the song is also added to that playlist.

Call `GET /api/user/upload-limits` first to confirm the user has remaining quota. In production this endpoint is served by the upload host (`idk.neurokaraoke.com`) rather than the main API.

**Requires a bearer token.**

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Title` | query | `string` | no |  |
| `Artist` | query | `string` | no |  |
| `PlaylistId` | query | `string` | no |  |

Request body `multipart/form-data`:

```ts
{
  File: binary
}
```

Response `200` OK

Response `401` Missing, invalid or expired credentials.

### `POST /api/user/song/download-from-url` — Upload a song from a URL

Auth: `Bearer`

Downloads the audio from a YouTube or Bilibili URL and adds it to the user's uploads. Only YouTube (`youtube.com`, `youtu.be`) and Bilibili (`bilibili.com`, `b23.tv`) video and playlist links are supported. Any other URL returns an error. Processing can take a while. Use a generous client timeout.

**Requires a bearer token.**

Request body `application/json`:

```ts
{
  url: string | null
  playlistId: string | null
}
```

Response `200` OK

Response `401` Missing, invalid or expired credentials.

### `GET /api/user/upload-limits` — Get upload limits

Auth: `Bearer`

Returns the user's current upload usage and remaining quota. Additional quota can be purchased in the shop with Neurocoin, Evilcoin or Twinscoin.

**Requires a bearer token.**

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  maxSongs: int
  maxStorageBytes: int64
  usedStorageBytes: int64
  currentSongCount: int
  currentPlaylistCount: int
  playlistLimit: int
  songPerPlaylistLimit: int
}
```

Response `401` Missing, invalid or expired credentials.

### `GET /api/user/songs` — List uploaded songs

Auth: `Bearer`

Returns all songs uploaded by the user.

**Requires a bearer token.**

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  id: string | null
  title: string | null
  opus: string | null
  oss: string | null
  cnPath: string | null
  absolutePath: string | null
  playCount: int | null
  duration: int | null
  streamDate: date-time | null
  dateAdded: date-time | null
  coverArtists: string[] | null
  originalArtists: string[] | null
  genres: string[] | null
  coverArt: {
    id: string | null
    fileName: string | null
    contentType: string | null
    description: string | null
    isAnimated: bool
    credit: string | null
    cloudflareId: string | null
    mediaStorageType: int  // Possible values: `0` = Blob, `1` = Cloudflare, `2` = Badge
    absolutePath: string | null
    artist: {
      id: string | null
      name: string | null
      socialLink: string | null
      userId: string | null
      arts: object[] | null
    }
    upvotes: int
    tagString: string | null
    mediaTag: int  // Possible values: `0` = Neuro, `1` = Evil, `2` = Twins, `3` = Hiyori
  }
  thumbnailArt: { …same as `coverArt` above }
  order: int
  hasLyrics: bool
  userUploaded: bool
  videoId: string | null
  hls: string | null
}[]
```

Response `401` Missing, invalid or expired credentials.

### `POST /api/user/song/{songId}` — Update an uploaded song

Auth: `Bearer`

Updates metadata (title, artist, etc.) for one of the user's uploaded songs.

**Requires a bearer token.**

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `songId` | path | `string` | yes |  |

Request body `application/json`:

```ts
{
  title: string | null
  artist: string | null
  mediaId: string | null
}
```

Response `200` OK

Response `401` Missing, invalid or expired credentials.

### `DELETE /api/user/song/{songId}` — Delete an uploaded song

Auth: `Bearer`

Permanently deletes an uploaded song and removes it from any playlists that contain it.

**Requires a bearer token.**

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `songId` | path | `string` | yes |  |

Response `200` OK

Response `401` Missing, invalid or expired credentials.
